# 怪水救援插畫紀錄

使用內建 ImageGen，三張獨立的故事插畫。科學標示與水路圖由網頁程式呈現。

## 角色與風格參考

- ch2：`dist/assets/story/forged-sword-together.png`，取用角色樣貌與木造工坊的繪畫風格。
- 本章既有 `saltfield-visit.png`，取用同一套服裝、比例與背包。
- 小葵：棕色側髮髻、白色帽衣、藍短褲、珊瑚色球鞋、浣熊背包、綠色筆記。
- 阿公：白色捲髮、圓框眼鏡、白袍、棕色背心長褲、領帶與黑色背包。

## 最終提示詞組

三張皆使用以下共同要求，再加上各自的場景要求：

> Input image 1 is the ch2 character and illustration-style reference. Input image 2 is a second exact character reference, not an edit target. Preserve the SAME two protagonists, recognizable face shapes, age, proportions and outfits in both references. Xiaokui: young East Asian girl, warm brown hair in a messy high side ponytail/bun, expressive brown eyes, cream hoodie, blue denim shorts, coral pink sneakers and brown raccoon backpack. Grandpa: elderly East Asian scientist with wavy silver hair, round black glasses, warm kind face, white lab coat over brown waistcoat, white shirt, dark tie and brown trousers, black backpack. Detailed luminous hand-painted anime storybook illustration, grounded richly textured Chinese historical architecture, cinematic warm light, matching the ch2 reference, not flat vector art. No sword, no gift chest, no portal, no written text, no symbols, no diagrams or labels, no watermark. Both characters are the protagonists and occupy 35–45% of the frame, clear full faces and natural hands. Wide landscape composition 4:3.

### 調查水路

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: science learning website hero and first investigation scene.

Scene: after a storm in an ancient imperial farming village. Grandpa and Xiaokui are prominent in the left foreground beside a stone irrigation canal and a CLOSED wooden sluice gate. Grandpa points at a broken earthenware workshop drainage spout near a stone junction in the midground; Xiaokui attentively writes in a green field notebook. Behind them are two timber and clay tiled-roof artisan workshops; farther right, waiting rice fields, misty green hills and a distant palace roof. Make the stone waterway physically believable, not a schematic. Water may look clear: the suspected contamination must NOT be portrayed as obvious fluorescent green poison. Damp stone and washed earth, morning sun returning after rain, thoughtful curious mood. No human touching or tasting water. An appealing, inviting narrative scene, two heroes clearly leading the investigation.

### 工坊研究

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: recurring science investigation illustration for interactive learning cards.

Scene: an airy imperial timber workshop temporarily used by the two protagonists to investigate water samples. Grandpa and Xiaokui stand close together behind a honey-brown wooden workbench, looking thoughtfully at THREE small CLOSED transparent sample bottles in a wooden rack. Xiaokui holds a green notebook and pencil, Grandpa gestures gently toward the rack without touching an unknown liquid. Both have calm focused smiles, full faces visible. The table also has a magnifier, a plain glass beaker of clear water, a blank rolled field map, and a neat wooden case with tools. Background soft windows, wooden shelves, ceramic jars and a distant view of the irrigation canal. No chemicals being poured, no dangerous fumes or open fire. Amber sunlight and soft sage-green shadows, rich ch2 texture, clear generous composition, enough breathing room around the faces. The two main characters carry the image, not equipment alone.

### 開閘結局

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: successful ending scene for learning website.

Scene: the SAME ancient farming village canal from the investigation, now restored. Grandpa and Xiaokui together operate the large WOODEN sluice wheel in the foreground, happy, relieved and proud. Clean water flows naturally through a stone-lined DEDICATED clear-water channel toward healthy green rice fields at right; the small workshop drainage is visibly kept in separate collection basins farther in the background, not flowing into the irrigation channel. Two tiny background artisans maintain separate ceramic-lined treatment vessels and covered collected solids. Focus on the heroes at the wooden gate, lush field, believable stone channels, distant tiled-roof artisan workshops and palace roof. Bright soft afternoon sunlight, joyful meaningful completion, matching ch2 cinematic storytelling. No futuristic pipes, no factory smokestacks, no text, and do not claim purity by showing magical sparkling liquid.
